issues.description: Ben's answer jumps to never working on weekends. It does not connect clearly to Anna's question about a job interview, so as an A2 listener I would feel confused about the situation.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the reply connected to the interview and the review words, for example: s1l2 text: 'No, I have never had a job interview, but I want to work.' vi: 'Chưa, mình chưa bao giờ đi phỏng vấn xin việc, nhưng mình muốn làm việc.' Then change s1l3 to 'What job do you want?' vi: 'Bạn muốn công việc nào?'

issues.description: If this line stays, 'công việc của mình' is a little ambiguous because 'mình' can mean 'me' or 'you' depending on context. For 'your job', a clearer translation would be better.
issues.suggested_fix: Change vi to 'Bạn có thích công việc của bạn không?' or more naturally: 'Bạn có thích công việc hiện tại không?'

issues.description: The grammar note uses the term 'past participle'. At A2, this may be too technical. I would understand better with a simpler form and an example.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the note to: 'Use have/has + ever + V3/-ed to ask about life experiences. Use have/has + never + V3/-ed to say you have not done something. Example: Have you ever had a job interview? I have never worked on weekends.'

issues.description: The hook is clear but very plain. It does not make me curious to listen.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the hook to: 'A short chat: Have you ever had a job interview?'

qa_report.summary: The episode is close to A2 and the vocabulary is clear, but the middle reply is not connected to the interview question, which would confuse me. A small rewrite and clearer Vietnamese phrasing would make it easy and natural to follow.
